summary: Main AI state-machine dispatcher. Reads the mode byte from event record a2+8; if this+0x184 differs, stores it and calls AIPitStrategyState on the vehicle pointer at this+0. Copies the float at a2+4 into this+0x188. Reads vehicle sub-state obj[3250] (obj+0x32C8); when it is 2 or 3 dispatches on the mode this+0x184: 2 -> sub_4A5EA0, 0 -> sub_4A5F20. Always calls ConditionalDispatch_55e0(this). Then for mode 1 or 2 queries VehicleControlEnabled(this) and, if this+8 is set, calls sub_4A3390(this+8, enabled==0); calls ConditionalDelegateDispatch(this+0, v14, v13); if this+0x10 is set calls sub_4A3320(this+0x10, v14, v13); if this+0xC is set returns sub_4A3320(this+0xC, v14, v13). For mode 0, if this+8 is set returns FlagBasedLoopConditionalCall(this+8). Otherwise returns the stored mode.

On mode change: call AIPitStrategyState(this[0]), passing the vehicle pointer at this+0x0.

Read the vehicle sub-state v5 = obj[3250] (obj+0x32C8) via the vehicle pointer at this+0; branch when v5 == 2 or v5 == 3.
Within the 2-or-3 branch, read mode v6 = this[97] (this+0x184); dispatch when v6 == 0 or v6 == 2.
Re-read result = this[97] (this+0x184); proceed when result is nonzero, then branch on result == 1 or result == 2.
If mode is 1 or 2: query v9 = VehicleControlEnabled(this).
If v10 = this[2] (this+0x8) is nonzero, call sub_4A3390(v10, v9 == 0).
If mode is 1 or 2: result = ConditionalDelegateDispatch(this[0], v14, v13).
If v11 = this[4] (this+0x10) is nonzero, call sub_4A3320(v11, v14, v13) and store its result.
If v12 = this[3] (this+0xC) is nonzero, return sub_4A3320(v12, v14, v13).
Mode 0 path: if v8 = this[2] (this+0x8) is nonzero, return FlagBasedLoopConditionalCall(v8).
Otherwise return result (the stored mode this+0x184).
